guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_hydr: The Hydra lives in Cavaryn's Toxic Caves and can lead the last wave of a Cavaryn horde. A witchcraft rite at night also calls one up, inside a full chalk circle with golden chalk at the center. It takes a Hint of Rebirth, Mutandis Extremis, Belladonna, a fermented spider eye and a frog as the sacrifice.
Its breath poisons. Every head you cut off grows back as two, up to nine, unless the Hydra is on fire.

It drops Hydra Fangs, which go into Big Bertha's blade, Hydra Arrows and the Double Stab book. Kill it yourself and it also drops the Hydra Heart. Kept in your hotbar, the heart heals you faster the more hurt you are.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_gorg: Gorgons live in temples on Overworld beaches. A witchcraft rite at night, in the same chalk circle as the Hydra's, also summons one with a mirror, a Siren Tear, a Mandrake Root and chiseled stone bricks.
Anything that meets her gaze turns to stone. A Blindfold keeps you safe, and so does Blindness.
She always drops her head. Hold up the Gorgon Head and whatever looks at it turns to stone.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_tame: A hatchling under 25 days old rides on your shoulder. From 50 days you can ride it. Sneak and click it with an empty hand to open its inventory, where dragon armor goes.

The Command Staff switches it between sit, stand and follow. Sneak-click with the staff to set or clear its home. A Dragon Horn stores it and lets it out again. The Dragon Bone Flute brings your own dragons down out of the air.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_hipp: Hippogryphs live in Elythia, and their coat depends on where they spawn: chestnut in the Truffalo Forest, cream on the Elythian Meadows and white over the Cloud Sea.

Drop rabbit's feet near one and it eats them until it's tame. Saddle it to fly. It also takes hippogryph armor and a chest. Two tame ones fed rabbit stew lay an egg, and a thrown Hippogryph Egg hatches a tame foal.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_cycl: A cyclops wanders Elythia's meadows and the Peach Forest, and the plains and meadows of the Overworld, herding sheep. Some live in sea caves on the coast. It attacks players on sight.
It stomps, kicks, or picks you up to eat you. A hit to the eye blinds it, and a blind cyclops loses track of anything more than a few steps away.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_hipp: Hippocampi swim in the Elythian Ocean and around the Coral Spikes.
Each piece of kelp you feed a wild one has a one in three chance to tame it. Saddle it for a fast mount underwater. Prismarine crystals breed two tame ones.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_deat: Death worms live in Cavaryn's Wormy Caves and turn up in Cavaryn hordes. They come in red, white and tan, and a big one blasts the ground apart when it strikes.
Throw a Death Worm Egg and the worm that hatches is tame.
Each color's chitin makes its own armor set. Only giant worms drop the Death Worm Tongue, which makes the Death Worm Gauntlet. The gauntlet lashes a target with the tongue and drags it to you.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_cock: Cockatrices live in Overworld savannas. Chickens near one start laying Rotten Eggs. Keep the coop somewhere else.
Throw a Rotten Egg and the cockatrice that hatches is yours. You can also tame a wild one by meeting its stare again and again.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_stym: Flocks roost in the Nadir Forest in Thoraxis. Kill one and the rest of its flock flees from you.

They drop copper, iron and Stymphalian Bird Feathers. The feathers make arrows that fly farther, a dagger with a very fast swing, and a Feather Bundle that fires feathers in eight directions. At the Enchanter they go into Arrow Inducting and Precise Volley.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_amph: A winged serpent you can ride
Amphitheres fly over Overworld jungles and Elythia's Ouranwood, Fungal Ouranwood and Peach forests.
To tame one, knock it out of the air with an arrow, climb on and stay on for about twenty seconds while it tries to bite you off. After that it's a flying mount.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_sea_: Seven colors, all of them angry
Sea serpents hunt the Overworld's oceans, the Elythian Ocean and the Coral Spikes. Some are ancient and far bigger than the rest, and they smash through blocks in their way.
Every one drops a Sea Serpent Fang and scales in its own color. The scales make Tide armor, which lets you breathe underwater and makes you stronger while you're wet.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_trol: Trolls live in Cavaryn. Forest trolls keep to the Wormy and Biowart Caves, and mountain trolls to the Moleworm Caves and Forlorn Hollows.
They fight with axes, hammers, tree trunks and stone columns. One time in three a dead troll drops its weapon. Otherwise it's just rubble.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_pixi: Pixies live in little villages in Elythia's Butterfly Fields, Peach Forest and Prismatic Grove. They come in pink, purple, blue, green and yellow.
Drop a cake near one to befriend it. Catch a wild one in an empty Jar instead, and it makes Pixie Dust over time.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_sire: Sirens live on small rocky islands out in the open ocean.

While she's calm, a siren sits on the rocks and sings. Anyone within about fifty blocks is charmed and drawn toward her. Earplugs block the song completely. Once provoked she stops singing and attacks.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_ghos: Ghosts rise from Graveyard Soil at night, and one comes out of a Cursed Chest the first time it's opened. Both are made with Ectoplasm.
Ectoplasm also turns up in haunted chests, and banshees, spectres and poltergeists drop it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.iaf_drea: An army of the frozen dead

The Dread hold the Dread Barrens, a frozen stretch of Thoraxis covered in dread stone and dreadwood. In the Overworld they guard mausoleums in snowy country, and Dread Liches also turn up in snowy biomes.
Thralls carry swords or bows. Ghouls, Beasts and Scuttlers fill out the ranks, and Dread Knights ride Dread Horses. A Lich raises more Thralls, Ghouls, Beasts and Scuttlers for as long as it lives.

Most ranks drop Dread Shards, which go into the Dark Nock and Impending Stab books at the Enchanter. A Lich you kill yourself drops the Gravemaster's Key. It opens the Dreadwood Keyhole inside a mausoleum.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.pest_cont: For when the bugs start winning.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.pes: One can. Point it away from your face.
Ant traps, four to a box.
Heavy steel traps. Not only for bears.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.nether_im: Imported from the Nether. Some of it is still warm.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.net: Slows down anything that walks on it.
Warm to the touch. Don't stand on it.
Bright yellow blocks, a little dusty.
Glowing fungus. Softer light than glowstone.
It's been like that since it arrived.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.polar_pro: Everything for the cold, and a lot of ice.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.pol: Won't melt, even next to a torch.
Packed snow, ready to build with.
Careful where you pour it. You'll sink.
Lets you walk on powder snow without sinking.
Somewhere warm to sit and cook.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.ant_facts: A quiz about ants, and the places they take you.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.witchcraf: Twelve questions every witch should get right.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.dragon_ri: Pass this before you try riding one.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.mcu_trivi: Questions from the movies. Popcorn not included.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.marvel_co: How well do you know the comics?
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_r: A crumbling castle in plains, forests, taiga and snow. A Mutant Zombie guards it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_w: A keep deep in forests, jungles and swamps. A Mutant Zombie guards it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_c: A walled fort on open plains and in forests. The Winter Soldier holds it.
A big stone castle in plains, forests and savanna. Red Skull holds it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_g: A granite fortress in plains, forests and savanna. The Winter Soldier holds it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_a: A fortified citadel on plains, forests and savanna. A Praetor guards the top.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.survey_ca: Survey notes on castles and forts, with directions.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_j: A large temple in the jungle. Skeletons guard it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_a: An old jungle temple. A Troll lives in it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_m: A temple built into the badlands.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_g: A shoreline temple with a hidden trapdoor. The Gorgon is below. Don't look at her.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_m: A cold tomb in snowy lands. Something old is buried here.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_s: A temple sliding into the ocean. A Deep One Mage is inside.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.survey_te: Old temples, old tombs, and how to find them.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_d: A black tower in forests, swamps and mountains.
A keep in the same dark places as the towers.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_c: Tunnels under forests and jungles. A Gravewailer is down there.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_m: A big house in the woods. A Vampire lives in it.
A white chateau on plains and in forests. The Horned Huntsman stays there.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_w: A keep in dark forests, taiga and swamps. A Mutant Skeleton guards it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.survey_ha: Places people don't go after dark. Directions included.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_d: Open nests where dragons sleep on their gold. Shows the nearest Monstrous Nightmare, Snow Wraith or Skrill roost.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_h: A cave in a swamp hill. The Hydra lives inside. Bring fire.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_c: A sea cave on the coast, usually near a flock of sheep.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_a: A hive dug underground. Something tall walks its tunnels.
A huge spider nest in forests and jungles. A Spider Pig guards it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_l: A deep dungeon under plains and forests. A Mutant Creeper waits at the bottom.
A frozen dungeon in snow and mountains. A Dread Lich rules it.
A dungeon under the desert. A Mutant Skeleton guards it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_c: An underground factory full of machines and guards.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_w: A monument in the deep dark. Be quiet.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.survey_de: The biggest dungeons anyone has mapped.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_t: A laboratory in the meadows. Someone still lives there.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_m: A royal castle with bedrooms, a kitchen and a treasury.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_t: The rarest landmark in Elythia. Pay your respects.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_f: A ruined castle from a kingdom that fell.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_s: A cheerful house with a very full kitchen.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_b: A lair in the ouranwood forests. Don't look at what lives there.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.survey_el: A map of the strangest places in Elythia.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_u: A castle in the dream dunes. Its treasury is still full.
Broken buildings in the dunes, some of them upside down.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.survey_s: A temple hanging from the roof of the Underside on the tip of a mountain, over the dream dunes. A ghost keeps it, and the Soul Stone with it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.survey_be: Maps of Cavaryn and the Underside.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.sur: They don't do much damage. Everyone nearby will still stop what they're doing.
A bottle of fuel with a rag stuffed in the top. Throw it, don't drink it.
Pulled out of old vests. A couple of dents, still good.
For a gun that's seen better days.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.rem: Grow your own mandrakes. Wear gloves when you pull them up.
Wolfsbane for the garden. Keep it away from the dog.
Pretty purple flowers. Don't eat them.
Picked fresh off a rowan tree.
Throw one at an animal and it'll be ready to breed.
Drink one to fall asleep and wake up in the Spirit World.
Plain candle holders. Candles not included.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.workshop_: Everything must go. The shop isn't closing, it's just very full.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.cle: Holds a little power for your machines.
A bag of silicon off the factory floor.
Moves items from one machine to the next.
The cheapest cores we stock. They still work.
Storage network cable, sold by the bundle.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.out: Good for climbing down and, more importantly, back up.
Shoot one at a wall and climb the rope it leaves.
Tells you how deep you are, or how high.
Always points the same way. Very loyal.
See it before it sees you.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.deep_dive: For people who'd rather be underwater.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.div: Glowing crystals from an ocean monument.
Dry, ready to soak up a room's worth of water.
Drink one and you can breathe underwater for a while.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.estate_sa: The Adams family would like everything gone by Tuesday.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.est: Seats four. Five if they're friendly.
Came out of a study. The drawers have been emptied.
Little shelves for putting things on display.
From the front hall. They've been cleaned.
Sold with the books still on them.
You won't know which ones until you hang them.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.seance_su: Candles, crystal balls and a coffin.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.sea: Blue light for a dark room.
They burn blue. Nobody knows why.
Wall lights with a cold blue flame.
Tall stands for a lot of candles.
Shows your curses and your tarot reading.
i can see you in it. why dont you ever look back
Three cards. Their luck lasts three days.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.record_de: Antazon will now buy your music discs. It does not want to hear them.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.relic_bro: Antazon pays for old pottery, armor trims, banner patterns and goat horns.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.taxidermi: Antazon now accepts heads. Please don't ask whose.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.rare_book: Any enchanted book, one flat price.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.treasure_: Found something shiny at the bottom of the sea? Antazon would like it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.gift_card: Insert into a computer to add 25 AntCoins to your account.
Insert into a computer to add 500 AntCoins to your account.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.seance_tr: The typed record of a séance. Someone kept notes the whole time.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.hive_spec: Clinical notes from somewhere underground. The last entries are cut off.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.obelisk_r: A rubbing taken from an old stone obelisk. One word, carved deep.
A rubbing taken from an old stone obelisk. One word, carved deep.
A rubbing taken from an old stone obelisk. One word, carved deep.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.obelisk_k: A heavy disk with three notches cut in the label.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.the_manor: A text game. You're invited to dinner. The host is late.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.creature_: A quiz about the creatures out there. Mob previews included.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.bloxiclea: Bloxiclean removes nearly anything from nearly anywhere.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.chronosph: Extended warranty for time. Terms and conditions apply, retroactively.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.lucid_eye: A help line card. Everything is fine.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.thoraxis_: Affordable underside property with excellent inverted gravity views!
task.integrated_boogaloo.start_here_flop: Floppy disks turn up in chests all over the world. Insert one into a computer, or use your phone while holding a disk in your other hand. The Disks app keeps every disk you've found.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.military_: Opens the military surplus section of Antazon. Everything is used. Most of it works.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.gift_card: Insert into a computer to add 100 AntCoins to your account.
A short text game about one very long night shift.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.damaged_d: The label has been scratched off. It's warm.
Someone at Bunker 7 knew the word.
Five questions a day. Get them all right and he pays you.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.disk.coldcraft: A glossy guide to the city everyone's talking about.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.sur: Holds a lot of rounds in one slot. Someone scratched their name off the lid.
From an army medical kit. Still sealed, mostly.
Gas grenades. Do not open the crate indoors.
Filled a whole room with these and the test subject just coughed. Amateurs.
task.integrated_boogaloo.hit_list_fire_d: Monstrous Nightmares live in deserts, jungles, savannas, badlands and mountains. They roost on the surface and nest in caves underground.
task.integrated_boogaloo.hit_list_gorgon: Gorgons live in temples by the beach. Wear a Blindfold, because meeting its eyes turns you to stone.
task.integrated_boogaloo.hit_list_mutant: It teleports when you hit it and throws blocks at you. Fight it somewhere open so you can see what's coming.
task.integrated_boogaloo.hit_list_baphom: My notes on this one just say "do not enter the catacombs alone", underlined four times.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.infinity: Two gauntlets can hold the six Stones. The Infinity Gauntlet is forged in a Starlit Factory from five Uru Ingots and a Downstone Fragment. The Nano Gauntlet is built around a Mark 43 chestplate with vibranium nanites.
To set a Stone, use it while a gauntlet is in your inventory. Each Stone gives two or three powers.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.cave_mag: Caves of red and blue neodymium in Thoraxis, and deep under the Overworld too. Scarlet Neodymium pulls iron and netherite gear toward it and Azure pushes it away, so come in other armor and tools.

Teletors float and swing an iron tool at you from a distance. Magnetrons build a body out of the blocks around them. Boundroids hang from the ceiling and slam down, and fall if you shoot the winch. Ferrouslimes merge into bigger ones. Notors scan you and show the others where you are.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.cave_tox: Glowing, and not in a good way
Radioactive caves in the upper part of Cavaryn, and deep under the Overworld too. Most things here leave you Irradiated, and the acid pools eat your armor first and you second.

Kill a Nucleeper before its core finishes closing, or it goes off like a bomb. Brainiacs lash you with their tongues and throw acid. Gammaroaches go after anyone Irradiated. In Cavaryn the Hydra lives here as well.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.cave_for: Pitch-black tunnels low in Cavaryn, and deep under the Overworld as well. Every light you place draws attention.

Gloomoths are harmless but swarm any light. Underzealots come in groups, smash torches and burrow away after each hit. Corrodents tunnel through the walls and flee from a torch. Vespers swoop from the ceiling. A shield block knocks one down.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.cave_pri: Huge jungle caves under Elythia, lit as bright as day, with more dinosaurs on the plains above. There are none in the Overworld. Nothing spawns here except the animals.

Grottoceratops and Relicheirus leave you alone unless you hit them. Vallumraptors hunt in packs led by an Elder, and the pack scatters if the Elder dies. The Tremorsaurus hunts everything. Subterranodons can be tamed with Trilocaris Tails and ridden.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.cave_aby: A flooded trench far below the Overworld's deep oceans. None of the ant worlds have one. Lanternfish shoals rise toward the surface at night, which is the easiest way to find it.

Deep Ones, Deep One Knights and Deep One Mages live here as one people. Hurt one and they all remember. Put a Pearl on an Abyssal Altar near them to trade and win them back. Mine Guardians are chained near the ruins and explode when you get close.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.cave_can: Caves of chocolate, cake and ice cream under Elythia, with the same candy above ground in places. There are none in the Overworld.

Caniacs leap at you and swing their cane arms. Gumbeepers fire bouncing gumballs, then rush in and explode. Caramel Cubes leave puddles that slow you down. Candicorns, Gummy Bears and the Gum Worm only fight if you start it.
advancement.integrated_boogaloo.gauntlet: Set all six Infinity Stones in one Gauntlet.
Trade a full Gauntlet to Dr. Trayaurus for a corndog.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.stone_mi: The King of Elythia drops it. He lives at his royal tree.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.stone_ti: The Queen drops it. She was thrown out of Elythia and lives in the underside of Thoraxis.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.stone_sp: It's in the chest of a Forsaken Cathedral, deep in Imbrifer.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.stone_po: Taken from the Devourer of Gods
The Devourer of Gods drops it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.stone_so: Someone has to die inside the Soul Temple, in the Underside. A tamed pet's death gives it to the owner, and a player's death gives it to the nearest person in the temple. Nobody gets it more than about once a week.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.stone_re: The Watcher holds it, down in the Solemn Falls at the bottom of Limbo. Everyone there when he falls gets one.
task.integrated_boogaloo.gauntlet_uru.de: Put Uranium Ingots and Stardust through a Foundry together. The Gauntlet is made of it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.gauntlet_gauntl: Forge it in a Starlit Factory from five Uru Ingots and a Downstone Fragment. I've drawn it so many times I could do it with my eyes closed.
task.integrated_boogaloo.gauntlet_mark_4: The other way to hold the Stones starts with a Mark 43 chestplate. No Uru needed.
task.integrated_boogaloo.gauntlet_nano_g: Build it around the Mark 43 chestplate with vibranium nanites and plutonium pellets. It holds the Stones just as well.
task.integrated_boogaloo.gauntlet_mind_s: The King carries it. He lives at his royal tree in Elythia. Bring Big Bertha.
task.integrated_boogaloo.gauntlet_time_s: The Queen carries it. She lives in the underside of Thoraxis. Bring Big Bertha.
task.integrated_boogaloo.gauntlet_space_: It's in the chest of a Forsaken Cathedral. A Mysterious Compass points the way.
task.integrated_boogaloo.gauntlet_power_: Summon the Devourer of Gods with a Cosmic Worm forged in a Starlit Factory. The name worries me.
task.integrated_boogaloo.gauntlet_soul_s: Nobody knows where this one is kept. Dr. T is looking, and he'll send word once he finds it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.gauntlet_realit: It's at the bottom of Limbo. Throw a Lucid Pearl while you're falling there, and take a weapon.
task.integrated_boogaloo.gauntlet_comple: Set all six Stones in either Gauntlet.
Fill a Gauntlet with all six Stones
task.integrated_boogaloo.gauntlet_gave_i: I have a trade for it at my lab, if you can bear to part with it. I'd take very good care of it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.gauntlet_snappe: Or keep it and use it. I'd understand. Mostly.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.herobrin: He looks like a player with white eyes. In the Overworld he only watches, usually from the treeline, though he has turned up behind people and next to their beds. He leaves as soon as you see him.
Small things change while nobody is near: candles go out together, torches turn red, a chest holds something you didn't put there, a door opens on its own. A sitting wolf knows when he's close.
In pocket rooms and the generated worlds, he's bolder. He walks straight at you and keeps coming when you look. Each generated world seems to have its own face for him.
A Dream Weaver of Nightmares by the bed seems to keep him out of your sleep.
What's at the bottom of Limbo
Throw a Lucid Pearl while falling in Limbo and it rises instead of landing. You keep falling, and you arrive somewhere quiet, with yellow walls and humming lights.

He is there in person. He only bleeds while you look at him, the lights die and the walls come apart, then the floor turns into a ceiling. Something keeps copies of the bosses you've beaten, without their colors.
He holds the Reality Stone. Dying there drops you back into Limbo, so you can try again. Once he's beaten, he stops following you.
task.integrated_boogaloo.hit_list_herobr: Something with white eyes keeps showing up at the edge of the map. Get a proper look at it, from a distance.
Find his lair at the bottom of Limbo and take the Reality Stone from him.
Defeat the Watcher in the Solemn Falls
task.integrated_boogaloo.hit_list_baron_: A masked swordsman leads some of Hydra's people. He blocks anything that comes at his front, so get round to his side.
task.integrated_boogaloo.hit_list_winter: Hydra keeps a soldier on ice in their cold bases. He's fast with a knife, so wait out his flurry before you swing.
Zemo carries a red notebook with ten words in it. Read them to the Winter Soldier once he's worn down or knocked off his feet.
Read the Red Book to the Winter Soldier
task.integrated_boogaloo.hit_list_red_sk: Hydra's leader carries a glowing blue cube. When he holds it up to heal, hit him three times to break it off.
advancement.integrated_boogaloo.weather2: Get close enough to study a tornado.
task.integrated_boogaloo.weather2_first_: A tornado passed close enough to study. Keep an eye on the weather.
task.integrated_boogaloo.weather2_storm_: Build instruments to track the wind, forecast storms, and warn when a tornado comes near.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.pastel_c: Topaz is cyan, Amethyst magenta and Citrine yellow, and their powders mix like paint. A Colored Sapling takes six Gemstone Powder, split between the colors in it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.pastel_g: Color comes from five gems. Topaz, Amethyst and Citrine grow in geodes. Onyx has to be fused, and Moonstone only grows below the bedrock.

Topaz geodes are huge and sit high in mountains. Citrine grows in the middle layers, sometimes close to the surface, and Amethyst in the deepest. Elythia has all three underground. Cavaryn and Thoraxis have none.
Drop an anvil on shards, buds or gem blocks to crush them into Gemstone Powder. Nearly every Pedestal recipe spends some.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.pastel_p: Color crafting happens on a Pedestal. It needs Gemstone Powder, open air or a container above it, and a tap from a Paintbrush or a redstone pulse to start.
The first Pedestal holds one gem. Craft the three-gem Pedestal on it and set the Focus around it. The Onyx Pedestal needs the Temple, and the Moonstone Pedestal, the last one, needs the Complex.
Colored Tree leaves drop Pigment when you break them by hand. Shears and Silk Touch only get you the leaves. Elythia's Prismatic Grove is full of wild Colored Trees.
An anvil dropped on colored leaves always crushes out some Pigment. The Truffalo Tufts of Elythia's Truffalo Forest crush into two Pigment each, in eleven colors.
Brown and black saplings need the Onyx Pedestal. White, gray and light gray need the Moonstone one.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.pastel_f: For things that need good timing
The Fusion Shrine sits in a 9 by 9 structure and needs a clear view of the sky. Pour a fluid into it, then click or throw the ingredients on. It takes whole stacks at once.
Many fusions only work at a certain time or in certain weather. Onyx needs a Shrine of lava at midnight, so bring a clock. A witch's Rite of Turn Midnight skips the wait.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.pastel_l: Liquid Crystal is gem energy in liquid form. Standing in it heals you, and some items dropped into it change.
Where it meets other liquids it sets solid. Water flowing in makes Frostbite Crystal, lava makes Blazing Crystal and Humus makes Clay.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.pastel_i: Imbrifer lies right under the Overworld, block for block, so you land beneath the spot where you broke through. No daylight reaches it. Beds work down here, respawn anchors don't.
Moonstone geodes grow here, bright white in the dark, and Bismuth grows in the Crystal Gardens. The air in the Dragonrot Swamp is poison.

The Forgotten Cities stand empty on the lower plains. Their moonstone temples are built from Moonstone Chiseled Basalt, and some cities keep Moonstone Cores in a vault. Preservation Turrets guard the vaults and sometimes drop a Core when you take one down.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.pastel_l: The Mysterious Locket waits in a Preservation Chest, behind the last of the three color puzzles in a Preservation Ruin.
Its clasp is jammed. Fused in a Shrine of Liquid Crystal with a Moonstone Core, 16 White Pigment and a Kraken Tooth, it opens. The tooth comes from the Kraken, which a witch can call up.
Inside is the Mysterious Compass. Its needle points to the Forsaken Cathedral, deep in Imbrifer.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.witchery: Attunement
Gems for witchcraft
On a basic Pedestal, a Whiff of Magic over a bucket of lava with five Gemstone Powder of one color makes an attuned gem of that color.
Attuned Topaz builds the Distillery and Attuned Citrine goes into candelabras. Attuned Amethyst goes into the Chalice, the Tarot Deck and the Bloodstone Pendant.
The Distillery
Splitting things apart
The Distillery splits one or two ingredients into several products. Every run uses up fired Clay Jars and a little altar power, so build it near the Altar.
Phantom Vapor, from Ectoplasm and Oil of Vitriol, goes into the Armor, Death Protection and Vampiric Poppets.
The Altar
Where the power comes from
Six Deepslate Altar Blocks set 3 by 2 form an Altar. Each block takes one Breath of the Goddess and one Exhale of the Horned One, so you need six of each.
The cauldron, the Distillery, the Brazier and every rite draw altar power, and only from an Altar close by. Trees and flowers around it raise how much power it has.
Mutandis
One plant into another
Mutandis turns a plant into a different one. For a few seconds after each use it stays within the same kind, so a sapling keeps turning into other saplings. Used on dirt it grows grass.
The Spirit World
Dreams and nightmares
A Brew of Sleeping sends you into a dream, or a nightmare. Wispy Cotton, Brew of Flowing Spirit and Dream Weavers near where you sleep make a nightmare less likely.
In a nightmare a Dreamstalker hunts you. Killing it drops Mellifluous Hunger, which you can carry back out. Nightmares also twist Wispy Cotton into Disturbed Cotton.
Vampirism
Ten levels of the night
Vampirism has ten levels. Level 2 comes once you fill your blood pool. Level 3 takes half the blood of five villagers, drunk without killing them. Level 4 takes three nights survived.
Level 5 takes ten burns from Sun Grenades. Level 6 takes twenty blazes, level 7 a poppy given to Lilith and level 8 two villages visited as a bat.
Lycanthropy
Ten levels of the wolf

Lycanthropy has ten levels. Level 2 takes three gold ingots at the Werewolf Altar. Level 3 takes twenty sheep killed and their mutton offered. Level 4 takes ten wolves killed and their tongues offered. Level 5 takes the Horned Huntsman.
Level 6 takes ten monsters killed in mid-air. Level 7 takes a howl at night in ten different places. Level 8 takes a pack of six wolves, and level 9 takes thirty piglins.
Summoning and Pets
Rites worth knowing
Three night rites call up something large, each in a wide ring around Golden Chalk: the Hydra, the Gorgon, and the Kraken, whose ring is Otherwhere Chalk.
task.integrated_boogaloo.inventory_pets_: Small pets made at a crafting table. Each one does something useful while it sits in your inventory.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.witchery: Summoning Death
Six of each

Death answers a Clay Effigy holding exactly six Spectres, six Gravewailers and six Poltergeists. Call the spirits at the Brazier, then perform Bind Spectral Creatures at night with the effigy within 16 blocks of the circle's center.
Every spirit in range gets bound, and one too many spoils the count, so keep strays away. A reversed Death card in a tarot reading can also send him to you at nightfall.

He blinks in behind you. Once he's hurt, his spirits shield him until you kill them, and he marks one fighter at a time: break his line of sight before the mark lands. Near the end he rings the fight with soul fire and won't let anyone leave.
Tarot
Three cards, three days
Right-click a Tarot Deck for a reading. It draws three cards, and they shape your luck for the next three days, some for better and some for worse.
A card can come up reversed, and reversed cards mostly work against you. A Crystal Ball makes reversed cards less likely.
task.integrated_boogaloo.start_here_back: Craft a Traveler's Backpack. It holds far more than your pockets, and B opens it while you wear it. Tier upgrades make it bigger, other upgrades add a crafting grid, a furnace or a magnet, and the themed backpacks each come with a trick of their own.
task.integrated_boogaloo.start_here_luck: You started with a Lucky Block. Before you break it, put it in a crafting grid with other things to change its luck. Things like gold, diamonds and golden apples make it luckier, and things like rotten flesh or spider eyes make it worse. Hover over the block to check its luck.
task.integrated_boogaloo.big_bertha_blad: Built around an Ultimate Sword, with a Basilisk Fang, a Kraken Tooth, a Hydra Fang and worse. I've listed where to find every piece.
task.integrated_boogaloo.big_bertha_hilt: Nightmare Scales, a Hercules Beetle horn, a demon heart and a Tremorsaurus egg, among other things. I've listed where to find every piece.
task.integrated_boogaloo.big_bertha_hand: Wings, claws, a Cyclops Eye, a raygun, a Red Death fang and one cooked corndog. The corndog was my idea. I've listed where to find every piece.
task.integrated_boogaloo.big_bertha_big_: The King and Queen block most of what you throw at them. Big Bertha gets through. Put her together before you go after either of them.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.witchery: The Witch's Garden
Seeds from the grass

Short and tall grass sometimes drops a witch's seed on top of its usual drop. Belladonna, Mandrake, Water Artichoke and Snowbell seeds each turn up about once in twenty breaks. Wolfsbane is a bit rarer, and Garlic drops the same way, ready to plant.
Mandrake Root goes into Mutandis, Golden Chalk and the Drop of Luck. Water Artichoke Globes go into many brews, the Brews of Love and Sleeping among them. Snowbells grow Icy Needles.
The Oven and Its Fumes
What each wood gives off

A Witches Oven is built around a Blast Furnace, in iron or copper. It smelts like a furnace, but wood leaves Wood Ash, and a fired Clay Jar in the side slot catches the wood's fume about half the time.
Each kind of sapling gives its own fume, and any log gives Foul Fume.
The Cauldron
Where the brews are made
A witch's cauldron needs water in it, fire under it and the Altar nearby. Add ingredients one at a time, in the order the recipe lists them. Stronger mixtures draw more power.
A mixture that turns brown has probably spoiled. A pinch of Wood Ash cleans the pot.
The Brazier
Incense and the dead
A Brazier burns three ingredients at once. Light it with flint and steel or a fire charge, and keep it near the Altar.
Brews
Cauldron drinks
Brews are stirred in the cauldron, then drunk or thrown. A Brew of Love sends animals into breeding. A Brew of Sleeping, made from one, takes you into the Spirit World.

Brew of Frost freezes water and chills whatever it hits. Brew of Ink blinds. Brew of Webs leaves cobwebs where it breaks. Brew of Wasting kills plants, and Brew of Erosion wears grass down to dirt and stone to rubble.
Poppets
Dolls that take the hit
A Poppet is hay bales, Spanish Moss, string and a Bone Needle. On its own it does nothing. Crafted into one of the kinds below, it works from your inventory.
Hunger Protection feeds you a little. Armor Protection repairs your armor just before it breaks. Death Protection saves you from dying once, and needs a Troll Skull and a Totem of Undying.

Voodoo Protection blocks voodoo aimed at you. A Vampiric Poppet bound with a Taglock passes some of your damage to its target. A bound Voodoo Poppet hurts its target when you drop it in water or fire, let it fall or stab it with a needle.
Altar of the Moon
The Werewolf Altar
The Werewolf Altar is stone set with two Attuned Moonstone, Wolfsbane and a Tongue of Dog. Wolves drop the tongues now and then.
Offer it three gold ingots and it gives you a Moon Charm. Werewolves come back to it later with mutton and tongues.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.pastel_t: A warm amber gem that holds light, made on the first Pedestal from Amber Moss Blocks and a Citrine Shard, three at a time. Tiger's Eye Shrines in Cavaryn sometimes keep a few in their chests.
Plenty of color recipes ask for it, among them the Bottle of Fading, the Onyx Pedestal, Liquid Crystal, Item Bowls and Ink Flasks.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.pastel_a: From Cavaryn: Amber Moss for Tiger's Eye, Uranium from the broodstone for the Bottle of Failing and the Enchanter, Broodfruit from the molting vines for Liquid Crystal, and Glowcap Mushroom Blocks for the Gemstone Lights in the Temple and the Complex.

From Thoraxis: Bluestone for the Bottle of Ruin, the Bottle of Decay Away and the Azure Dike gear. Vortex Charges go into several Enchanter books and Pedestal upgrades, and Antimetal into the Ring of Aerial Grace. Ichor from its pools makes more Midnight Solution.
From the End: Dragon's Breath, also for the Bottle of Ruin.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.pastel_e: The Enchanter makes enchanted books from a book, ingredients and experience. It can push an enchantment past its usual limit, and it enchants gear without using the book up.
It works inside an 11 by 11 structure with eight Item Bowls. The placer is crafted on the Onyx Pedestal once you've stood in Liquid Crystal. A Knowledge Gem stores experience to feed it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.pastel_m: The Midnight Aberration falls apart soon after it's fused, and the fusion spills Midnight Solution around the Shrine.

Midnight Solution hurts any creature standing in it. Creatures it kills drop Midnight Chips along with their usual loot. Enchanted items thrown in come out plain and give back experience, and a few other items turn into something else.
More Solution comes from a witch's cauldron: a bucket of Ichor from Thoraxis, a Midnight Chip and black pigment.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_bellad: Mandrake Seeds: the root goes into Mutandis and Golden Chalk
Water Artichoke Seeds: the globes go into most brews
Snowbell Seeds: they grow Icy Needles
Wolfsbane Seeds: for the Werewolf Altar
Break short and tall grass. Now and then it drops a witch's seed instead of wheat seeds.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_oven.o: Build an iron or copper Witches Oven
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_oven.c: Clay Jars: four clay balls make four
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_oven.j: Smelt the Clay Jars before use
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_oven.d: Build a Witches Oven around a Blast Furnace. It needs a Jar in its side slot to catch anything.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_first_: Catch all five
Wood Ash: left by anything you cook
Whiff of Magic: Rowan or Colored Saplings
Breath of the Goddess: Birch, Cherry or Peach Saplings
Exhale of the Horned One: Oak, Dark Oak or Duplicator Saplings
Foul Fume: any log
Bottled Air
Cook saplings and logs with a Jar in the oven. Each kind of wood gives off something different, and the Jar catches it about half the time.
Six altar blocks set 3 by 2 make an Altar. Nearly everything from here on draws on its power, so build it where you'll work.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_attune: Make Attuned Topaz, with cyan powder
Attuned Amethyst: amethyst powder, for the Chalice and Tarot
Attuned Citrine: yellow powder, for candelabras
On a basic Pedestal, set a Whiff of Magic over a lava bucket with five Gemstone Powder of one color.
Three paper, a Whiff of Magic and an Attuned Amethyst make a deck. Right-click it for a reading.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_distil: Jars, copper blocks, deepslate bricks and an Attuned Topaz. Keep it near the Altar, since every distillation draws a little power.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_first_: Make Ritual Chalk
Gypsum: Foul Fume and Wood Ash, distilled
Tear of the Goddess: Breath of the Goddess and a Siren Tear, distilled
Ritual Chalk
Distill Foul Fume with Wood Ash for Gypsum, and Breath of the Goddess with a Siren Tear for a Tear of the Goddess. Chalk is Gypsum, Wood Ash and a Tear.
Get an iron or copper witch's cauldron
The Cauldron
A cauldron and a campfire make a witch's cauldron. It only works with the Altar nearby.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_mutand: Mandrake Root, from a grown Mandrake
Stir Mandrake Root, Exhale of the Horned One and a Radium Shard into the cauldron. Use it on a plant to turn it into another.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_golden: Stir Mandrake Root, a gold nugget and Ritual Chalk into the cauldron. Golden Chalk marks the center of every circle.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_infern: Stir Wraithing Flesh, Blaze Powder, Treacherous Wax and Ritual Chalk into the cauldron. The flesh and the wax both come from the Nether.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_otherw: Stir Warped Fungus, a Tear of the Goddess, an Ender Pearl and Ritual Chalk into the cauldron. Its circles reach distant places.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_first_: Defeat the Spectral Pig
Drop of Luck, stirred in the cauldron
Arthana
Ectoplasm, dropped by the pig
A First Rite
Ring Golden Chalk with Ritual Chalk and set a Drop of Luck, a porkchop, a gold nugget and an Arthana inside. Right-click the center to call up a Spectral Pig.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_necrom: Attuned Onyx, from the Onyx Pedestal
At night, set Attuned Onyx, a bone, rotten flesh, Wood Ash and Ectoplasm in the same circle.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_from_a: Creatures from other lands can be remembered too. Where there's no head to offer, a skull or something the creature drops takes its place.
Watch a Memory of one manifest
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_back_a: A remembrance rite leaves you a Memory, not the creature. Set it down and wait for it to hatch. It goes faster on Magma, and on ice it never hatches at all.
Neolith: use it in place of Vegetal and nobody can tell what's inside
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_whack_: Bosses can be remembered too, but only once you've hatched an ordinary Memory. Before that the circle just gives your offerings back.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_spawne: Put the Golden Chalk right on top of a spawner and ring it with Ritual Chalk. Each catalyst nudges one setting up to a cap, but no spawner will listen until you've broken one with a Resonance tool.
Change a spawner with a rite
Break a spawner with a Resonance tool
A wider circle with an Infernal ring swaps a spawner's creature for the one in a Memory. Bosses, villagers and evokers won't take.
Give a spawner a new creature
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_brazie: Iron bars, iron ingots and the Necromantic Stone. Light it with flint and steel to burn incense and call up the dead.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_moon.t: Tongue of Dog, dropped by wolves
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_moon.m: Attuned Moonstone, from the Onyx Pedestal
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_moon.d: Wolfsbane, a Tongue of Dog and Attuned Moonstone from the Onyx Pedestal make a Werewolf Altar. Offer it three gold ingots for a Moon Charm.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_werewo: You run with the pack now. Your bite lunges at a foe and heals you a little, and later the Moon Charm lets you change form.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_brew_o: Stir a poppy, a golden carrot, a lily pad, cocoa beans, a Whiff of Magic and a Water Artichoke Globe into the cauldron.
Icy Needle, from a grown Snowbell
Stir a cookie, a Whiff of Magic, an Icy Needle, a Brew of Love and a Water Artichoke Globe into the cauldron.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_spirit: Drink a Brew of Sleeping and dream. Eat an Icy Needle in the dream to wake up.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_distur: Wispy Cotton grows wild. A Nightmare twists it into Disturbed Cotton.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_dream_: Phantom Vapor, Tormented Twine and a Dreamweaver Charm. Placed near your bed, it changes what you dream.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_bone_n: A bone and flint make a Bone Needle. With a glass bottle it makes a Taglock, which takes a sample from a creature or a player.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_poppet: Hay bales, Spanish Moss, string and a Bone Needle. Spanish Moss hangs from trees in the wild.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_guardi: Carry a protection poppet and it takes the harm meant for you. The Hunger one is just four carrots, and the Death one needs a Troll Skull and a Totem of Undying.
task.integrated_boogaloo.witchery_vampir: You belong to the night now. Each bloodline you climb deepens the curse and changes what you can do.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_first_ge: Topaz geodes grow high in mountains, Citrine in the middle layers and Amethyst deep down. Find your first geode to unlock all three shard refills at Antazon.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_first_pe: Crush gem buds in an anvil for Gemstone Powder, then build a Pedestal. Tap it with a Paintbrush to start a craft.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_tigers_e: Amber Moss grows on the walls of Cavaryn's caves, thickest in the Glowcap Caves. Fuse two with a Citrine Shard on the Pedestal for three Tiger's Eye. A full set of Tiger's Eye armor lets you press R to blend into the block under your feet.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_fading.g: Collect the Vegetal it leaves behind
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_fading.d: Place a Bottle of Fading beside pumpkins, melons or leaves and wait for Vegetal. Obtaining Vegetal unlocks refills and surplus sales at Antazon.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_first_pi: A sapling, Vegetal and a dye make a Colored Sapling on the Pedestal. Grow it and break the leaves by hand.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_cmy_pede: Upgrade the Pedestal with all three gems. Then craft the Focus placer on it and set the Focus down around it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_gem_gear: Make a Multitool or a Bag of Holding
The three-gem Pedestal makes useful tools. The Multitool is a pickaxe, axe and shovel in one, and the Bag of Holding carries a lot.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_fusion_s: Craft the Fusion Shrine placer on the Pedestal. The Shrine needs a clear view of the sky.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_onyx.des: Fill the Shrine with lava and fuse Topaz, Amethyst and Citrine at midnight; a witch's Rite of Turn Midnight saves the wait. Your first Onyx unlocks shard refills and Polished Onyx crates at Antazon.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_onyx_ped: Upgrade the Pedestal with Onyx. The recipe takes Tiger's Eye too.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_temple.d: Craft the Temple placer on the Pedestal, using a spare Onyx Pedestal, and set it down around yours.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_every_ba: Collect all twelve basic pigments. Brown needs black powder, so its sapling waits for the Onyx Pedestal and the Temple.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_shooting: Follow a Shooting Star's trail at night; Night Vision and a Spyglass help you spot one. Finding a Star Fragment unlocks refills at Antazon.
Collect the Neolith it leaves behind
A Bottle of Failing eats obsidian and leaves Neolith behind. Obtaining Neolith unlocks refills and surplus sales at Antazon.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_liquid_c: Broodfruit grows on molting vines in Cavaryn's Brooding Tunnels, Glowcap Caves and Wormy Caves. With Tiger's Eye and pink and yellow pigment, the Pedestal turns it into Liquid Crystal.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_enchante: Craft the Enchanter placer on the Pedestal and set it down. It makes enchanted books from pigment and experience.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_perfect_: Fill the Shrine with Liquid Crystal and fuse Topaz, Amethyst, Citrine, Onyx and Neolith on a clear day. It won't last.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_midnight: Creatures that die in Midnight Solution drop Midnight Chips; the Bottle of Ruin needs two. Obtaining chips unlocks refills and surplus sales at Antazon.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_ruin.des: Two Bluestone, two Midnight Chips and Dragon's Breath make a Bottle of Ruin. Bluestone only grows in Thoraxis, and Dragon's Breath comes from the End.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_bedrock_: Wear a full set of Bedrock Armor
Fuse Ultimate armor with Bedrock Dust in Midnight Solution, then wear the full set.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_imbrifer: Go through the black portal the Ruin opens. Imbrifer lies right under your own world.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_moonston: Moonstone geodes grow in Imbrifer, bright white in the dark; a shard upgrades the Pedestal one last time. Obtaining one unlocks Moonstone refills at Antazon.
The Complex placer needs Moonstone Chiseled Basalt you can't make yet. Borrow some from the structures in Imbrifer.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_grays.de: With the Complex built, white, gray, light gray and black pigment finish the palette.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_forgotte: Empty cities stand on Imbrifer's lower plains. Machines guard their vaults.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_moonston: Take a Moonstone Core from a city's guarded vault. Charge your Bluestone Dike before crossing its force-field gates; see Shield Up.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_locket.d: Solve the third color puzzle in a Preservation Ruin and take the Mysterious Locket.
Kraken Tooth, dropped by the Kraken
Fuse the Locket with a Moonstone Core, sixteen White Pigment and a Kraken Tooth in a Shrine of Liquid Crystal. Inside is a compass, and it points somewhere.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_preserva: Ruins of unbreakable stone near the top of the deepslate hold color puzzles, and one guards the Mysterious Locket. Their force-field gates need charged Bluestone Dike; see Shield Up.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_titratio: Fill it with ingredients and a bucket of water and seal it with colored planks. It keeps aging in real time even with the world closed, and some drinks want days.
Tap a drink from the barrel
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_suspicio: Seal small flowers in a barrel with water. Each flower gives the same effect it would in suspicious stew, and a longer wait makes it last longer.
task.integrated_boogaloo.pastel_sweet_ja: Jade Wine is sprouted Jade Vine bulbs and petals in water. A bottle of Moonstruck Nectar from a vine in full bloom sweetens it, and the hangover gets a lot gentler.
Moonstruck Nectar, bottled from a blooming vine
task.integrated_boogaloo.hit_list_kraken: A witch can call the Kraken with ink, a Heart of the Sea and a Drop of Luck in an Otherwhere circle at night.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_arrival: Right-click a Brown Ant to ride it to Elythia, or sacrifice one in a Mossy Ouranwood frame for a portal that stays. Of the three, it is the gentlest.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_lab.des: My lab is somewhere in the meadows. I put a survey of it in your Archive so you can find it. Come say hello, and bring corndogs to trade!
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_fallen_: A ruined castle stands in the meadows. Its old king left his crown behind.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_spirit_: Shear an Apple Cow Glimmer and it drops a Spirit Apple. It grows back in about two minutes.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_glimmer: Frog: Glimmering Pools and Ouranwood Forest
Ouranwood Deer: Glimmering Pools and Ouranwood Forest
Apple Cow: Glimmering Pools and the Meadow
Feed a wild Glimmer a Spirit Apple to tame it. Each kind is born somewhere different, so tame one of each.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_truffal: Collect a Truffalo Tuft in the Truffalo Forest, then grow a sapling from it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_caterpi: Caterpillars crawl through the meadows and fields. Help one grow up.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_glimmer: Small glowing pools scattered across Elythia. Glimmers gather there.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_peach_f: Peach trees and ponds. A Peach Sapling cooked in a Witches Oven gives Breath of the Goddess.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_butterf: Open fields full of butterflies. Pixies like it here too.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_cloud_s: It only forms high in the sky, in about one region in five. Stratosharks swim through it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_coral_s: Coral towers rise out of the warm shallows. Sea serpents hunt nearby.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_prismat: Colored trees grow wild here. You'll need their colors.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_ginkgo_: An old forest of ginkgo trees and moss. Ancient beasts graze in it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_candy.d: Parts of Elythia are made of sweets, above ground and in the caves below. Don't eat the bears.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_primord: Dinosaurs still live in the caves under Elythia, and on the plains above them.
Pixies build little villages among the flowers. Leave a cake out if you want a friend.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_stratos: Stratosharks swim through the Cloud Sea. Their fins go into Big Bertha, and into soup.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_soup.de: Cook the fin into Stratoshark Fin Soup and eat it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_flytrap: Flytraps grow in patches in the Ouranwood forests. Big Bertha's hilt needs their goo.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_alpha_m: An Alpha Mantis leads the mantises in the meadows and Truffalo forests. Bring your best weapon.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_basilis: Basilisks hunt the Ouranwood forests, and some keep a lair. Don't let one look at you for long.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_brutalf: Cocoons hang under the Ouranwood canopy and stay quiet until something damages them. Once one hatches, the only way out is through it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_toreter: A coliseum sits in an Elythia ocean, and the Toreterror guards it. Its shell cannon fires water hard enough to hurt.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_ant_arc: Defeat a Basilisk and the Toreterror, and take a Brutalfly Elytra. Then Elythia is yours.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_sea_ser: Sea Serpent Fang, for Big Bertha
Sea serpents hunt Elythia's oceans and the Coral Spikes. Their fangs go into Big Bertha.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_cyclops: A wandering cyclops herds sheep across the meadows and the Peach Forest. Its eye goes into Big Bertha.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_amphith: Feathered serpents glide over the Ouranwood and Peach forests.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_ancient: Huge old creatures roam the forests, meadows and seas. Defeat one of each.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_kings_t: The King lives alone in a great tree in the meadows. He attacks the moment he sees you.
task.integrated_boogaloo.elythia_king.de: Mid-fight he issues Decrees: kneel, don't run, come no closer. Break one and your hearts are halved for thirty seconds.
He left an egg. Hatch it and feed the Prince golden things until he grows big enough to ride.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_arrival: Right-click a Termite to ride it down, or sacrifice one in a Myrmite frame for a portal that stays. It never sees daylight.
Termites won't chew wood that's lit by a torch, and they walk away from the light. Daylight doesn't count, so light up anything you build.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_attenti: Kill one of the horde's creatures
Staying put, killing and breaking eggs all draw the hive. Keep moving and an area cools down.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_glowcap: Glowing mushrooms light these caves. Amber Moss and molting vines grow thickest here.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_broodin: Eggs cling to the ceilings of these tunnels. Springbugs hatch from them.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_biowart: Fleshy, warted caves. Jerries live here, and so do trolls.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_molewor: Moleworms tunnel through here, and something bigger hunts them.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_wormy.d: Worms of every size, up to the Death Worms tunneling through the walls.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_toxic.d: Radioactive caves with green pools and glowing creatures. Bring protection.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_forlorn: The darkest caves in Cavaryn. Things down here have never seen light.
Both grow in the broodstone here, and a little in Elythia and the Overworld. Iron Man suits run on them. Uranium ore breaks into Raw Uranium Scrap, and each scrap smelts into a nugget. Don't pack the scrap into Raw Uranium unless you're feeding an Atomic Forge, because Raw Uranium won't smelt.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_ultimat: Collect a full set of Ultimate armor
Titanium and Uranium make Ultimate armor and the Ultimate Sword, the strongest metal gear there is.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_myrmite: Myrmite Coal Ore drops ordinary coal. It's the easiest fuel down here.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_amber.d: Amber Moss grows on the cave walls, and Broodfruit hangs from molting vines. Color crafting needs both.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_bug_mea: Cook some Bug Meat and eat it. It tastes better than it sounds.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_springb: Springbugs hatch from the eggs on the Brooding Tunnel ceilings. Their legs go into Big Bertha.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_jerry.d: Jerries live in the Biowart Caves. Keep the nucleus.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_death_w: Death Worms tunnel through the Wormy Caves and surface under your feet.
Trolls live in the deep caves, where no sunlight can turn them to stone.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_molevor: The Molevore hunts the Moleworm Caves. Its nose goes into Big Bertha.
Shrines of Tiger's Eye hide underground. Breaking the Tiger's Eye wakes a horde, so be ready first.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_awakene: Break a Tiger's Eye, or smash enough eggs and kill what comes out, and the horde wakes. It comes in waves.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_hercule: The Hercules Beetle charges hard enough to move the ground. It marches with the horde.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_beetle_: Once a Hercules Beetle is hurt, feed it Broodfruit and it bonds with you.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_attitud: A Hercules Horn, a block of Uranium and netherite make an Attitude Adjuster.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_hydra.d: The Hydra lurks in the Toxic Caves and rises with the final waves. Cut one head and two more grow.
task.integrated_boogaloo.cavaryn_survive: Survive a horde to the end
Survive the horde through its final wave. Something much bigger sleeps deeper down, and I'd rather it stayed asleep.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_arriva: Right-click a Red Ant to ride it there, or sacrifice one in a Nyxite frame for a portal that stays. It's the hardest of the three, and beds don't work.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_upside: Gravity flips once you go far enough below center. Dimensional tears flip it too, for a while.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_bluest: Bluestone wires like redstone but reacts the opposite way. Color crafting needs it too.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_gravit: Uranium, Titanium, a Lucid Eye, netherite and a Bluestone Comparator make a Gravity Gun. It pulls in creatures and blocks and throws them.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_stinky: Get Stinky. It keeps passive creatures away and draws every bug for miles.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_dream_: Dunes of Dream Sand. Scorpions and Manticores roam them.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_umbral: Dark hills where Nightmares and Reveries drift.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_lucid_: Still pools ringed with Blood Crystal spires. Lucids hunt here.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_nadir_: A dark forest deep in Thoraxis. Bronze-feathered birds nest in it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_vortex: Storms walk here as Vortexes. The rock is veined Typhonite.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_nightm: The worst of Thoraxis. Demons and imps have moved in here.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_dread_: A frozen dead army marches across these barrens, led by liches.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_magnet: Caves where the metal floats and the creatures are made of it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_hive.d: Something built a hive of resin down here, and it lays eggs. Do not stand near the eggs.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_brood_: Temples where the worst of the hive things are kept. Go in prepared or not at all.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_blood_: Blood Crystal Apple: two more hearts for two minutes
Blood Crystal grows in spires in the Lucid Pools. Each armor piece gives a Bloodglass Heart that blocks one hit, shatters, then recharges in thirty seconds.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_bed_bu: Don't Let the Bed Bugs Bite
Bed Bugs are everywhere in Thoraxis. Squash one.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_reveri: Reveries drift through the Nightmare Wastes and Umbral Hills. Sometimes one decides to follow you.
Lucids hunt the Lucid Pools. Keep their eyes.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_lucid_: A Lucid Eye and an Ender Pearl make a Lucid Pearl. Throw it and you land where it lands, upside down.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_vortex: Vortexes roam the Vortex Expanse. Their charges call storms at a Fusion Shrine.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_demons: Demons, imps and lice have crept into Thoraxis. A demon heart goes into Big Bertha.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_mantic: Manticores prowl the Dream Dunes, and they serve the Queen.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_nightm: A Nightmare hits harder the lower your health gets. Past half health it opens two portals, so watch both.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_empero: Emperor Scorpion Stinger, for Big Bertha
The Emperor Scorpion rules the Dream Dunes. Its stinger goes into Big Bertha.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_whip.d: Take its tail and make a Scorpion Whip.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_i_am_t: Defeat a Lucid, a Nightmare and the Emperor Scorpion. Then Thoraxis knows your name.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_dilati: Time Dilation slows you down. Some creatures and devices cast it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_contra: Time Contraction speeds you up instead.
Have both at the same time
Have both at once. Nobody is sure what that does to you.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_throat: Gravity throats are holes through the bedrock floor. Jump in fast and you fall through into the Underside.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_unders: A castle hangs in the Underside, and the Queen is somewhere below it.
She fights with gravity: shockwaves, black holes and a field that pins you down. In her last phase she slows time around her.
task.integrated_boogaloo.thoraxis_prince: She left an egg. Hatch it and feed the Princess until she grows big enough to ride.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.foo: Four corndogs, cooked and ready to eat.
I once traded uranium for a corndog. I would do it again.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.amm: A box of Compact Copper Rounds.
A box of Standard Copper Rounds.
A box of Compact Advanced Rounds.
Pull the pin, then throw. In that order.
launched a rocket at Logan just to see if he would catch it. he threw it back at me and I'm still regrowing my limbs. 9/10
Gunpowder for ammo and explosives, without the sulfur hunt.
The working part of most guns.
A heavy barrel for the bigger guns.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.mat: Empty bottles for brewing and witchcraft.
Nickel Nuggets, used in most ammo.
Nickel Ingots for machines and ammo.
Quartz Enriched Iron for storage systems and suits.
Polymer Plates for vehicles and machines.
One spoonful of Rainbow Sugar. The most expensive sugar there is. Limited to 5 a day.
two thousand coins for SUGAR. ate it with a spoon and could hear colors for six hours. would sell a kidney for more, I have spares, they grow back
One Titanium Ingot. Limited to 64 a week.
One Titanium Nugget, for when you only need a little. Limited to 144 a week.
One Uranium Ingot. Limited to 64 a week.
One Uranium Nugget, for when you only need a little. Limited to 144 a week.
One Gold Titanium Ingot. Limited to 16 a week.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.luc: Break it and see what happens. Some of what happens is bad.
Eight Lucky Blocks for the price of seven.
Somehow all of Mumbo's antcoins lagged into my account and I've somehow spent them all on lucky blocks. lag is getting crazy these days
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.gea: Pour it on rot that's eating the ground and the rot stops. Keep a bottle on you.
Works on small patches. For anything bigger, ask about our rot removal package.
Torches, corndogs and a little iron. For starting over.
A spare backpack. One per customer.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.mat: Four Spirit Apples, freshly shorn. Glimmers love them. Limited to 2 orders a week.
Eight Broodfruit, picked from the molting vines. Beetles and color crafters both want them. Limited to 2 orders a week.
Two Lucid Pearls. Throw one and land upside down. Limited to 2 orders a week.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.cri: A Reverie in a bottle. Let it out wherever you like. Returns not accepted.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.hat: One hat a day. Tomorrow it's a different one.
today it was a hat shaped like a fish, tomorrow who knows. I have bought 41 hats. Dont tell Colossus, he thinks I have a problem
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.foo: The best food you can carry. Good for long trips.
A six-pack of Root Beer. Keep it cold.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.amm: A box of Krahg Rounds. Heavy.
Grenade rounds for launchers. Aim away from the lab.
A box of Beowulf Rounds, with titanium cores.
A box of Gibbs Rounds, with titanium cores.
A frame for building iron guns.
The working part of the faster guns.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.mat: A stack of Iron Ingots, for when the mine is too far away.
Leather for books, backpacks and armor. No cows harmed on our end.
Blank books for bookshelves and enchanting.
Eight blocks of Obsidian, already mined.
Four Ender Pearls. Throw them carefully.
Bottled experience. Break one and it's yours.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.amm: A full quiver and then some. Bow not included.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.mat: Eight Blocks of Redstone, already packed.
Made a 27x27 piston door in a 3x3 space. It's really quite simple.
One Diamond. Limited to 16 a week.
I bought one Diamond for Wade as a reward for good behavior. He has not behaved. I am keeping the Diamond until he does.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.gea: Give something a name. It will never leave you after that.
Named a sheep after myself. It hasn't stopped changing colors since.
A saddle, for anything that will let you ride it.
Tried it on a Gronckle and it ate the stirrups. Fine on a horse.
Turns a wooden chest into an iron chest, contents included.
Turns an iron chest into a gold chest, contents included.
Turns a gold chest into a diamond chest, contents included.
computer.integrated_boogaloo.product.mat: Four motors, eight magnetic coils and two Improved Machine Cores. Limited to 2 orders a week.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_nic: Nickel is the metal every machine starts with. Look for its ore in caves, or for ore boulders on the surface.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_gen: A Basic Generator burns anything a furnace would and turns it into power. Every machine after this needs some.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_ass: The Assembler puts four parts together into one, faster than any table. Half the parts on this map come out of it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_cen: The Centrifuge spins ore clumps into gems and coal dust into carbon fibre. Gems smelt into more metal than raw ore does.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_pol: Or a Radon Bottle from the toxic caves
Polymer Plates need Naphtha from the Refinery. Mix it with sand into polymer resin, then add sulfur dust.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_pro: The first real chip. Assemble it from a Polymer Plate, carbon fibre, electrum and redstone.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_las: Aim an Enderic Laser with a Target Designator. It mines whatever is in its way and carries power to the big machines.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_cri: Blood Crystal grows in Thoraxis, and a laser harvests its clusters fast. Two shards, a Processing Unit and titanium make a Crimson Gate.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_ato: The Atomic Forge needs eight machine cores around it and only takes power from a laser. It builds every chip from here on.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_ace: Forge a Processing Unit with two Silicon Wafers. The Refinery washes sand into silicon.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_ai_: Two Advanced Computing Engines and a pinch of Bedrock Dust make a Super AI Chip. The dust comes from a Bottle of Ruin.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_com: Forge an Adamantium Ingot, a Super AI Chip and an Unholy Intelligence together. It keeps very small things where they belong.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_pro: Forge a Heisenberg Compensator, an Overcharged Crystal and a uranium ingot into Prometheum. Nothing else makes it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_ult: Four Prometheum, four plating and a Superconductor make the Ultimate Machine Core. The best suits are built around it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_pul: The Pulverizer grinds ore into dust, and dust smelts into more ingots. It also grinds gem shards into powder.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_fou: The Foundry melts two metals into an alloy: electrum, biosteel, and Uru from uranium and stardust.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_mor: A Basic Generator only goes so far. Upgrade to steam, lava, biofuel or a Big Solar Panel.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_unh: Fill a Dubious Container from an Allay or a Vex. What comes out is clever, and a little rude.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_ove: Two Rainbow Sugar, a Blood Crystal shard, four Superconductors and two Advanced Batteries make an Overcharged Crystal.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_exo: Make any Exosuit piece or a jetpack
Plated armor with a motor in the legs and a battery in the chest. A jetpack straps on later.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_ref: Oil gushes out of the ground in deserts. Bucket or pump it into a Refinery for Naphtha, fuel and silicon.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_cyb: Research upgrades for your own body at a Research Station, then install them at the Augmentation Center.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_rea: Fuel rods need vibranium and polymer, and pellets need uranium. Mind the heat.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_sup: Assemble a Crimson Gate, electrum, a Dubious Container and vibranium. The magnetic caves offer a neodymium recipe too.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_acc: A ring of Accelerator Rings with the controller in it. Collide two things fast enough and you get a third.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_ext: Ore boulders on the surface mark endless ore nodes in the bedrock below. Titanium and uranium nodes give scrap, forever.
task.integrated_boogaloo.marvel_engineer: Every suit is built or upgraded at a Suit Table. It takes eight titanium around an Assembler.
Four copper gems, four cyan radon lamps and a netherite ingot. Radon comes from the toxic caves in Cavaryn.
Build any piece of the MK1
Built in a cave from scraps: iron, black cloth, a basic machine core and the arc reactor.
Build any piece of the MK2
Titanium plating and an Improved Machine Core. It flies, if you charge it first.
Build any piece of the MK3
Gold titanium and Gold Gems, around an Advanced Machine Core. The classic red and gold.
Build any piece of the MK5
The suitcase suit. It needs an Elite Machine Core: eight Adamantium around an Advanced Computing Engine.
Build any piece of the MK7
From the MK6 on, suits need the Titanium Arc Reactor and an Ultra Machine Core, which takes eight Bedrock Dust.
Build any piece of the MK11
A Super AI Chip, an Overcharged Crystal and reactor parts. The suit starts doing some of the thinking.
Build any piece of the MK19
Superconductors and quad reactor rods. From here the marks change color with their radon lamps.
Build any piece of the MK25
The first suit with an Ultimate Machine Core and a Heisenberg Compensator. Built for heavy lifting.
Build any piece of the MK33
From the MK28 on, each suit is built around a piece of Ultimate armor. Bring the full set.
Build any piece of the MK43
The last mark: gold titanium blocks, uranium and an Ultimate Machine Core in every piece.
Suits run on power. Charge them on a Suit Charger, an Equipment Charger or a power network.
Build any piece of War Machine
Built on an MK2 frame, with titanium, Iron Gems and a crossbow where the subtlety used to be.
Build any piece of the War Machine MK2
A nuclear bomb and a fissile core on the shoulders. Repaint it at the Suit Table and it becomes the Iron Patriot.
A satellite that drops a giant suit on request. Build it from a Big Solar Panel and a Processing Unit.
The MK38 is a working suit with its own dock. It charges on a Mark 38 Charger.
Vibranium ore is in the Overworld, more often under savannas. It soaks up energy, which the best machines need.
Titanium, netherite and vibranium make Adamantium, the hardest metal there is.
One titanium and one gold ingot make Gold Titanium, the plating of the classic suits.
A motor and a small tank on each wrist. Refill them with vials of web fluid.
Use an empty syringe on a grown villager. It won't thank you. Your first sample opens a page on every serum in the Archive.
Spin a blood sample in the Centrifuge to separate out the X-Genes.
Brew a uranium nugget into a water bottle. Pym Particles shrink or grow whatever they touch.
Build a Shrink Ray or a Growth Ray
A Pym Particle and a netherite ingot power either ray. Titanium makes the Growth Ray, uranium the Shrink Ray.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.tech_bas: Every machine runs on power, and the first power comes from a Basic Generator burning furnace fuel. Nickel goes into the generator, the motor and most early parts.
Bigger machines need machine cores placed around them. Better cores only raise how many addons a machine can take, but the suits use cores as parts, so you will make every tier eventually.
The Pulverizer turns ore into dust, and the Foundry melts metals into alloys like electrum.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.tech_ass: The Assembler combines four inputs into one part. Motors, Processing Units, Crimson Gates and every serum come out of it.
The Centrifuge separates things. Ore clumps become gems, which smelt into extra metal, and coal dust becomes carbon fibre. With a fluid addon it also handles liquids.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.tech_pol: Crude oil gushes from the ground in deserts. A Refinery splits it into heavy oil, Naphtha and acid, and also washes sand into silicon.
Mix Naphtha with sand for polymer resin, then add sulfur dust for Polymer Plates. A radon bottle from the toxic caves and a bucket of Naphtha can stand in for the resin.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.tech_las: An Enderic Laser fires in the direction a Target Designator sets, up to 128 blocks. It mines everything in its path, so check what is behind your target.
Aimed at a machine, a laser carries power instead. The Atomic Forge and the Bedrock Extractor only take power this way.
Blood Crystal clusters in Thoraxis give six shards each to a laser. Shards make Crimson Gates, which most advanced machines need.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.tech_ato: The Forge needs eight machine cores around it and power from at least one laser. Each recipe charges it up before it finishes, so more lasers mean faster work.
It makes Silicon Wafers, Advanced Computing Engines, Super AI Chips, Heisenberg Compensators and Prometheum.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.tech_thi: An Advanced Computing Engine is a Processing Unit forged with two Silicon Wafers. Two of them and some Bedrock Dust make a Super AI Chip.
Unholy Intelligence comes from filling a Dubious Container with an Allay or a Vex. Forge it with a Super AI Chip and Adamantium for a Heisenberg Compensator.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.tech_pro: The Atomic Forge turns a Heisenberg Compensator, an Overcharged Crystal and a uranium ingot into one Prometheum.
Four Prometheum, four plating and a Superconductor make the Ultimate Machine Core. It also makes tools that never seem to slow down.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.tech_rea: A reactor is a box of Reactor Walls with a controller, rods and ports. Rods take vibranium and polymer, and uranium pellets take uranium, polymer and nickel.
Rods make heat as well as power. Vents and heat pipes carry it away. If the heat has nowhere to go, the reactor will find somewhere.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.tech_acc: Build a loop of Accelerator Rings, feed in particles from the controller, and collide them. Faster collisions make rarer results.
It makes stardust from moonstone powder and glowstone, a Heavy Core from reinforced deepslate, and one very unusual serum.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.suit_arc: The Netherite Arc Reactor is four copper ingots and four cyan radon lamps around a scrap of netherite. The Titanium Arc Reactor wraps one in titanium and light blue lamps.
Suits are built at a Suit Table. Upgrading uses up the old suit piece, or you can build any mark directly around plain armor.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.suit_mar: MK1 to MK5, and War Machine
MK1 is iron and cloth. MK2 adds titanium, MK3 gold titanium and Gold Gems, and MK5 an Elite Machine Core and ion thrusters.
War Machine starts from the MK2 frame. Its second mark carries a nuclear bomb, and the Suit Table can repaint it as the Iron Patriot.
MK6 brings the Titanium Arc Reactor and the Ultra Machine Core. MK7 adds an Advanced Computing Engine, and MK11 a Super AI Chip.
MK15 to MK24 trade parts for radon lamp colors and superconductors. MK25 is the first with an Ultimate Machine Core and a Heisenberg Compensator.
From MK28 on, each piece is built around a piece of Ultimate armor. MK30 also needs an Ultimate Sword, MK37 pure resources and a Heart of the Sea.
MK42 and MK43 use gold titanium blocks and Ultimate Machine Cores. The MK38 is a work suit with its own charging dock.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.suit_pow: Suits hold power and spend it on flight, repulsors and everything else. Later marks hold far more.
Charge them on a Suit Charger, a Mark 38 Charger, an Equipment Charger, or anything else on your power network. Veronica tops them up from orbit.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_la: An empty syringe used on a grown villager gives a blood sample. The Centrifuge separates X-Genes from it.
Each serum is assembled from a syringe and three ingredients. Most need X-Genes. The super-soldier serum needs the blood itself, and one serum only forms in a particle collision.
task.integrated_boogaloo.boogaloo_forewo: Ants here carry you to three worlds of their own, and most of what's worth finding is in them. I'm writing all of it down, and the long goal is the Infinity Gauntlet. The Antroduction tab covers the basics.
task.integrated_boogaloo.boogaloo_ant_co: Brown Ants nest in forests, taigas and plains. Right-click one to ride it to Elythia, the gentlest of the three worlds. My lab is there, not that I've seen much of it.
