task.integrated_boogaloo.boogaloo_termit: Termites build nests of their own in the same forests, taigas and plains. Right-click one to ride it down to Cavaryn, which never sees daylight.
task.integrated_boogaloo.boogaloo_red_an: Red Ants nest in the Nether and attack on sight. Right-click one to reach Thoraxis, the hardest of the three. Please be careful.
task.integrated_boogaloo.boogaloo_rainbo: Feed a Rainbow Ant some Rainbow Sugar
Rainbow Ants nest in the same forests and plains. Feed one Rainbow Sugar and it carries you somewhere different every time. I've started a separate notebook just for these.
task.integrated_boogaloo.boogaloo_suit_u: Get any superhero suit or serum
Build any superhero suit or take any superhero serum. Iron Man starts in The Workshop, under Marvelous Engineering. Powers go on R, G, V, C and X, and the Controls page in the Archive has the rest.
Get a Pedestal, Wood Ash or a Whiff of Magic

Make a Pedestal for gem magic, or catch the fumes from burning wood in a Jar for witchcraft. Gem magic is in A World of Color and witchcraft is in Witchcraft. I don't understand either one, which is why I need you.
task.integrated_boogaloo.start_here_over:
Every tab has its own map. Open the list on the left to move between them.

<yellow>The Big Boogaloo</> is the main path, from your first day to the Infinity Gauntlet {item:integrated_superheroes:infinity_gauntlet, green:false}. The rest can wait, and you can take them in any order.

Something in this world has made every creature tougher than it should be, and I haven't worked out what. How much tougher depends on the difficulty:
Peaceful and Easy: <red>1.5x health</>, <red>1.25x damage</>
Normal: <red>2.5x health</>, <red>2x damage</>
Hard: <red>3x health</>, <red>2.5x damage</>
Antarchy: <red>5x health</>, <red>3.5x damage</>, and far more of them show up in enchanted armor.

Some also spawn with extra powers, and their names list them, so a long name means trouble. Wear armor before you pick a fight.

The tasks around this one are worth knowing in your first few days. <dim>When a task is done, open it to claim the reward.</>
task.integrated_boogaloo.start_here_anta: Read Dr. T's mail about Antazon
Antazon sells almost anything for AntCoins and delivers it to wherever you are. It buys some things back, too.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_copper_: The first step up from a wooden chest. Each chest after it holds more than the last.
Put a carved pumpkin on a copper block. The golem takes items out of copper chests and drops them into nearby chests that already hold the same thing.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_gold_ch: Upgrade kits turn a placed chest into the next kind without emptying it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_diamond: From here the line splits two ways.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_obsidia: The same size as a Diamond Chest, but explosions can't break it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_crystal: The same size as a Diamond Chest, and you can see what's inside without opening it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.start_here_tran: A Transmogrification Table makes any armor look like any other without changing what it does. Your inventory also has cosmetic armor slots, and whatever you put there is what people see.
task.integrated_boogaloo.start_here_morp: I had Grim give you something a while back. Now when you kill a mob, you can take its form, and the morph selector switches between every form you've collected. Press [ or ] to open it and Enter to pick a form.
task.integrated_boogaloo.start_here_grav: When you die, everything you were carrying stays in a grave where you fell. Go back to it to get your things.
task.integrated_boogaloo.start_here_mine: A one-use tool that carves out a whole mine in one go. You can make one once you have a diamond pickaxe.
task.integrated_boogaloo.start_here_temp: Later on, a Tempad saves places you've been and opens a door back to them. It's built in The Workshop, under Marvelous Engineering.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_control: Every storage network starts with a Controller. It needs power, and Processing Units to build.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_grid.de: Disks go in a Disk Drive, and a Grid shows everything stored on the network. Join them to the Controller with cable.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_first_d: Storage disks are put together in an Assembler from a storage part and a Polymer Plate. A disk counts items, not kinds, so a 1k disk holds 1,000 of anything.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_bigger_: Each storage part is made from the size below it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_disk_64: The 64k part needs Advanced Computing Engines.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_disk_25: Past 64k, the parts need titanium and Bluestone, and each disk needs Blood Crystal Shards. Both come from Thoraxis.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_disk_16: From 16384k up, the parts take vibranium instead of titanium.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_disk_10: This part needs Super AI Chips and adamantium.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_disk_in: The last part needs Heisenberg Compensators and Bedrock Dust. It never fills up.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_io.desc: Importers pull items into the network and Exporters push them out. Put one on a machine's side and set a filter to choose which items.
Fluid disks are made the same way, with empty buckets in the parts.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_wireles: A Wireless Transmitter and a Wireless Grid reach the network from anywhere in range. Both need titanium and Radiating Ender.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_network: A Network Transmitter and Receiver link two parts of a network that are far apart. They need vibranium.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_craftin: A Grid with a crafting table built in. It pulls ingredients straight from storage.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_externa: Put an External Storage on a chest or barrel and everything in it joins the network.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_storage: It shows how much you have of one item. Sneak and right-click to pick the item, right-click to put some in, and left-click to take a stack.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_redston: A Detector gives a redstone signal when you have more or less of an item than the amount you set. A Relay switches the part of the network past it on and off.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_disk_in: It empties a disk into the network, or fills one from it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_upgrade: Speed Upgrades make Importers and Exporters work faster, and Stack Upgrades move more each time.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_regulat: In an Exporter, a Regulator Upgrade only tops the target up to the amount you set. Use it in your hand to set the amount.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_range.d: Range Upgrades in a Wireless Transmitter make its reach wider. More transmitters cover more ground too.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_securit: A Security Manager locks the network, even for you, so put a Security Card for yourself in it first. Allowlist Modules in it let players in, and Denylist Modules keep players out.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_compact: Throw nuggets or ingots in and it turns them into blocks on its own. You can switch the pattern in its screen.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_heartbo: A double chest only you can open. If anyone else tries the lid it gives off a weak redstone signal, so you can wire up an alarm.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_bottoml: Holds as much of one item as you can find. Power makes it bigger, and Curse of the Void deletes what won't fit, which is perfect for cobblestone.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_node_ne: Nodes move items between chests with no cables and no power. Put a Sender Node on the chest you fill and a Storage Node on the one where things should end up, then link them with a Tuning Stamp.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_every_n: Provider Nodes share a chest without emptying it. Gather Nodes only pull what their filter asks for, and Buffer Nodes keep stock ready for them.
Use every kind of node in one network
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_node_up: Use a material on a node to upgrade it, and crouch-use with an empty hand to take it back. Blood Crystal moves more per trip and Bluestone adds filter rows.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_black_h: Pulls in dropped items from up to 12 blocks away. A Knowledge Gem inside soaks up experience too.
task.integrated_boogaloo.storage_bag_of_: Opens your Ender Chest from anywhere.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.tech_sec: Everything here belongs to whoever placed it. Other players can't break your reinforced blocks or get past your locks without the code, a matching card, or a place on your Allowlist.
Keycards also lock Secure Access Doors. Allowlist and Denylist Modules work in a storage network's Security Manager too, and a Security Card starts as a Keycard.
task.integrated_boogaloo.locked_down_pas: Place a Key Panel and right-click it to set a code. The right code sends a redstone signal.
task.integrated_boogaloo.locked_down_loc: Right-click a placed chest, barrel or furnace with a Key Panel to lock it behind a passcode.
task.integrated_boogaloo.locked_down_fai: A Secure Trading Station sells to other players for the price you set, even while you're away.
task.integrated_boogaloo.locked_down_rei: Put blocks in a Universal Block Reinforcer to make reinforced versions that only you can break. The level 2 one can turn them back too.
task.integrated_boogaloo.locked_down_key: A Keycard Reader sends a redstone signal when a matching card is swiped. Right-click it to set the levels it accepts, then link your cards to it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.locked_down_cle: Higher-level cards use rarer metals, up to vibranium at Level 5.
task.integrated_boogaloo.locked_down_sec: Sneak-use a keycard on a Secure Access Door to lock it to that card's level. After that, it only opens for someone holding a card of that level or higher.
task.integrated_boogaloo.locked_down_who: Put an Allowlist Module in a lock to let players through without the code, or a Denylist Module to ban them.
task.integrated_boogaloo.locked_down_net: The same modules fit in a storage network's Security Manager. Denylisted players are locked out even with a Security Card, and allowlisted players get in without one.
task.integrated_boogaloo.locked_down_eye: Right-click a Security Camera with a Camera Monitor to link it, then watch it from anywhere.
task.integrated_boogaloo.locked_down_tri: Two Laser Blocks up to five blocks apart make a beam that catches anyone who isn't you or allowlisted. An Alarm sounds while powered.
task.integrated_boogaloo.locked_down_got: A Cage Trap boxes in any player who touches it, except you.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_tem: A Tempad saves places you've been and opens a door back to them. It needs Time Steel, made from uranium and netherite scrap.
task.integrated_boogaloo.start_here_loot: Chests you find in the world have their own loot for each player. Friends exploring the same place won't empty them for you.
task.integrated_boogaloo.start_here_port: Portal Guns are rare. Look in treasure chests in old structures and dragon caves, or build one from titanium, Antimetal and Rift Pearls. Antazon sells them too. They have everything these days.
task.integrated_boogaloo.start_here_rand: Randomium Ore drops something different every time you break it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_wre: One Wrench does it all: it sets up machines and pipes, rotates blocks, links furniture to power and works the special doors.
task.integrated_boogaloo.engineering_fur: Lights, appliances and other powered furniture run off generators and energy storage. Link each piece to one with the Wrench, up to twelve per source.
task.integrated_boogaloo.hit_list_weepin: Angel statues only move when nobody is looking at them. Keep your eyes on one and bring a pickaxe. Ordinary weapons don't hurt it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.hit_list_mutant: It grabs you and throws you. Knock it down and it gets back up a few times, so don't walk away early.
It fires several arrows at once. What's left of it afterward is worth keeping.
It jumps, charges and calls in Creeper Minions. Don't fight it near anything you built.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.tech_rep: Replication breaks things down into eight kinds of matter: Earth, Ender, Living, Metallic, Nether, Organic, Precious and Quantum. A Replicator builds them back up into anything it has a pattern for.
Common things cost little matter. Rare things cost a great deal, and a few cost so much that copying them isn't worth it. Each matter type has its own sources, and the rare kinds are the bottleneck.
task.integrated_boogaloo.replication_rep: Collide a Uranium Ingot with Antimetal in the Particle Accelerator to get three Replica Ingots. Everything here is made from them.
task.integrated_boogaloo.replication_net: The Terminal runs everything, and Matter Tanks store the matter. Connect them with Matter Network Pipes.
task.integrated_boogaloo.replication_dis: The Disintegrator breaks items into matter and sends it to your Matter Tanks. Most items give a mix of the eight kinds.
task.integrated_boogaloo.replication_pat: Scan an item in the Identification Chamber to save its pattern to a Memory Chip. Slow mode only uses up the item once the scan is finished.
task.integrated_boogaloo.replication_blu: A Blueprint carries one pattern, and a new one already holds the Replicator Motor. Sneak and right-click a Chip Storage to load it.
task.integrated_boogaloo.replication_rep: Pick a pattern at the Terminal and the Replicator builds it from stored matter, as long as you have enough of every kind it needs. It needs power.
task.integrated_boogaloo.replication_mot: You can't craft one, but you can copy one. Fit it to a Replicator to control its speed.
task.integrated_boogaloo.replication_enc: It makes a Replicator faster, and hungrier for power.
task.integrated_boogaloo.replication_mat: Stone, dirt, sand and gravel are pure Earth. It's the cheapest matter, and almost everything needs some.
Plants are Organic. Most of them give some Earth too, and logs and saplings give the most.
Iron, tin, lead and nickel ingots are pure Metallic. Rarer metals add something extra on top.
Diamonds and emeralds are pure Precious. Gold, quartz and amethyst carry some too.
Netherrack is pure Nether, but each block only gives a little. Ancient Debris holds far more.
Chorus Fruit is the best source of Ender. End Stone and Ender Pearls give a little.
Creatures and food give Living matter. A Bottle o' Enchanting is pure Living.
Quantum is the rarest kind. Bluestone Dust is pure Quantum, and uranium and Nether Stars hold a lot of it.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_sp: Passive: agility, wall-crawling, a super jump and spider sense. The last three can be switched off from the Spider Abilities wheel.
Active: Web Swing, Web Zip, web gadgets (Web Shot, Web Net, Impact Web) and spider attacks (Spider Kick, Spider Sting). Every web needs Web Shooters and web fluid.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_sp: Spider-Man's power: a Fermented Spider Eye, a Uranium Ingot and Uranium in the Assembler. You get agility, wall-crawling, a super jump and a spider sense. Web-swinging and web shots need Web Shooters worn as an accessory, loaded with web fluid.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_su: Passive: agility, Strength I and Resistance I at all times, plus Speed I and Jump Boost I. Crouch and jump for a Super Leap: three times the height, and farther while sprinting.
Shield Charge is a damaging dash, half again as strong with a shield in your off-hand (8 s). Rally gives Strength and Resistance to every player within 12 blocks for 10 seconds (45 s).
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_su: Captain America's power, no X-Genes needed: a Villager Blood Sample, a Uranium Nugget and a Golden Apple. You're permanently stronger, tougher and faster, and you can leap three times higher. Shield Charge hits harder with a shield in your off-hand, and Rally boosts everyone nearby.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_pa: Passive: agility, Strength II, Speed II and Jump Boost II, and a 60% chance to deflect arrows. Heightened Senses gives Night Vision and makes monsters within 24 blocks glow.

Panther Pounce (6 s). Claw Swipe slashes everything in front of you and makes it bleed (4 s). Ancestral Plane: a killing blow leaves you at half health with Regeneration and Resistance instead, once every 10 minutes.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_pa: Black Panther's power: a Lightning Dragon Heart, a Mandrake Root and Wolfsbane. You're fast and strong, you deflect most arrows, and you can see enemies through walls. Once every ten minutes, the Ancestral Plane brings you back from a killing blow.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_da: Radar Sense outlines living things through walls within 32 blocks, or 48 in the dark. You're immune to Blindness and Darkness, and you dodge one projectile in five.
Billy Club bounces up to three times (3 s). Grapple Line pulls you to a block, with no fall damage until you land (4 s). Takedown dashes in and stuns (10 s).
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_da: Daredevil's power, no X-Genes needed: an Echo Shard, a Demon Heart and a Uranium Ingot. Radar Sense outlines every living thing through walls, and you fight with a bouncing billy club, a grapple line and a stunning takedown. Blindness and Darkness can't touch you.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_sq: Call the Swarm brings 8 squirrels (2 s). Sic 'Em sends them at a mob, or to guard a block (1 s). Squirrel Pile holds a target down for 3 seconds (20 s).
Swarm Orders: Defend, Forage, Gnaw (they dig out up to 64 connected blocks) or Stay. Passive: agility, plus Speed and Jump Boost you can switch off.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_sq: Squirrel Girl's power, no X-Genes needed: an Ouranwood Acorn, a Tongue of Dog and a Rabbit's Foot. Call a swarm of squirrels to fight, guard, forage or chew through stone for you. Tippy-Toe rides on your shoulder.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_hu: Hulk Out switches between Banner and the Hulk (3 s). Banner can't use any other ability. The Hulk is half again as big, so you need room to change.
Thunderclap knocks back everything in front of you (10 s). Hulk Smash sends out a shockwave ring (4 s). Gamma Leap: crouch and jump for a huge leap that lands with a shockwave.
Rage fills the experience bar as you fight, making you stronger with shorter cooldowns. A blow that would kill Banner turns him into the Hulk instead, once every 3 minutes.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_hu: The Hulk, no X-Genes needed: a Potion of Chemical X, a Nuclear Bomb and a Villager Blood Sample. Hulk Out to grow huge and green, then smash, clap and leap. Rage builds as you fight, and at full rage Banner turns into the Hulk whether he wants to or not.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_ic: Freeze Blast freezes everything in a cone (7 s). Cryogenesis freezes everything around you (18 s). Ice Wall raises a wall of ice (10 s).
Ice Slide: sprint to build an ice ramp wherever you look, and ride it through the air. Ice Form gives Resistance, but fire hurts half again as much while it's on.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_ic: Iceman's power, and the easiest mutant serum to make: X-Genes, Blue Ice and a Frost Lily in the Assembler. Freeze enemies in a cone, burst cold around you, raise ice walls, or sprint to build an ice ramp you can ride through the air. Ice Form toughens you but makes fire hurt more.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_cy: Optic Blast fires a beam that destroys terrain (2 s). Wide Blast fires a fan of beams (4 s).
Without a Cyclops visor on, your eyes fire on their own: a wobbling, uncontrolled beam that cuts through anything. Neither ability works until the visor is on.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_cy: Cyclops's power: X-Genes, a Blood Crystal Shard and a Lucid Eye. Fire a beam that cuts through terrain, or a wide fan of them. Wear a Cyclops visor first: without one, your eyes fire on their own and you can't stop them.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_qu: Speed Force: switch it on, then sneak and scroll to set your speed from 1 to 10 times. Hunger drains faster the faster you go, and it switches off when you're starving.
Bullet Time slows everything within 64 blocks for 12 seconds (60 s). Sonic Boom needs at least three times speed and hits harder the faster you go (6 s). You take a quarter of normal fall damage.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_qu: Quicksilver's power: X-Genes, Rainbow Sugar and a long Potion of Temporal Contraction. Switch on the Speed Force and set how fast you are, up to ten times, then slow time around you or hit with a sonic boom. Running fast makes you hungry fast.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_ki: Phase: walk through blocks and take no damage. While phased you can't attack, use or place anything. After 20 seconds you turn solid and get pushed out of any wall. Some blocks can't be phased through.
Phase Strike ignores armor (5 s). Phase Sink roots a mob in the floor (12 s). Phase Others takes an ally through walls with you for 8 seconds (20 s).
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_ki: Kitty Pryde's power: X-Genes, Ectoplasm and World Thread. Phase to walk through walls and take no damage, but you can't attack or use anything while phased. The phase meter lasts 20 seconds before you're pushed back out.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_co: Steel Form: you're bigger and much tougher, bullets and arrows ricochet off, and fire does half damage. You're 20% slower, you sink in water, you slow down in lava, and Magneto can grab you.
Fastball Special throws an ally or a mob (6 s). In Steel Form only: Steel Charge (8 s) and Iron Slam (10 s).
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_co: Colossus's power: X-Genes, a Block of Titanium and a Block of Iron. Turn to steel to grow bigger and tougher, bounce bullets and arrows off, and charge or slam. In steel form you're slower and sink like a rock.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_st: Lightning Strike (6 s, or three bolts every 3 s in a storm). Gale throws a wind vortex (12 s). Storm Aura makes you immune to lightning and stronger in rain, and you can fly.

Weather Control has its own wheel: Clear, Rain, Thunderstorm, Hail, Blizzard, Sandstorm, Winds or Tornado, held within 192 blocks for 5 minutes. The tornado tears up blocks. Some weather only works in the Overworld.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_st: Storm's power: X-Genes, an Eye of the Storm and Lightning Dragon Blood. Call lightning, blow enemies away and fly, or change the local weather to anything from clear skies to a tornado. Lightning strikes faster in a storm.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_ma: Magnetic Grip lifts and throws metal: mobs in metal armor, golems, anyone with adamantium bones, and up to 48 magnetic blocks (6 s). Magnetic Crush hits armored targets harder (8 s).
Weapon Swarm sends up to four metal weapons from your hotbar or off-hand to fight on their own (25 s). Magnetic Shield turns arrows back and reflects bullets. Flight only works in metal armor.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_ma: Magneto's power: X-Genes and Scarlet and Azure Neodymium Ingots. Grab and throw anything made of metal, crush armored enemies and send your weapons to fight for you. You can only fly while wearing metal armor.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_sc: Hex Bolt is a homing orb with a random hex (1 s). Telekinesis grabs and throws any mob or block, with no cooldown.

Reality Warp turns up to eight non-boss monsters within 10 blocks into animals that drop nothing (180 s). Hex Field gives enemy attacks a chance to fizzle, and once a minute a killing blow misses you.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_sc: Scarlet Witch's power: X-Genes, Happenstance Oil and a Midnight Aberration. Throw hex bolts, lift anything with your mind and fly. Reality Warp turns nearby monsters into harmless animals.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_wo: Claws come out and go away on command. Wolverine attacks: Berserker Barrage, Drill Claw, Tornado Claw and Pounce. Track Scent follows a trail.
Passive: fast healing and climbing with your claws. A killing blow knocks you down for a few seconds instead, twice before one sticks. Adamantium bones count as metal, so Magneto can grab you.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_wo: Make the Weapon X: Wolverine serum
Wolverine's power: X-Genes and two Adamantium Ingots. Pop your claws to fight and climb, follow scents, and heal fast. Claw hits land very hard.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_de: Passive: agility, fast healing, and status effects cleared every second. Guns hit 25% harder, and you dodge the first hit from a mob that just spotted you. A killing blow knocks you down instead, up to three times, and each revive is weaker.

Unload fires 8 shots at nearby enemies with a gun in hand (6 s). Pull the Pin throws a grenade, if you don't drop it (8 s). Retcon puts you back where you were 5 seconds ago (20 s). The Fourth Wall wheel holds Smash Cut (back to your bed), Pause Menu (freezes nearby mobs) and Rage Quit (smashes your screen and knocks back everything nearby).
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_de: Make the Weapon X: Deadpool serum
Deadpool's power: X-Genes, a Totem of Undying and a Cooked Corndog. You heal constantly, get back up from killing blows, and fight best with a gun in hand.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_hu: Flame On: fly, burn, and set things alight with your fists. Water or rain puts you out, and you can't flame on while wet. Fire and lava can't hurt you.
Fireball has almost no cooldown. Flame Cage traps a target for 4 seconds while you're flamed on (12 s). Nova Flare blasts everything within 8 blocks, then leaves you burned out for 10 seconds (30 s).
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_hu: The Human Torch: a Star Fragment, Fire Dragon Blood and a Blaze Rod. Set yourself alight to fly and punch with fire, throw fireballs, cage enemies in flame or go nova. Water and rain put you out, and you're immune to fire and lava.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_in: Vanish: turn fully invisible, and monsters lose track of you. Attacking ends it.
Force Field raises a wall for 10 seconds (12 s). Force Bubble cuts damage to a quarter and bounces projectiles for 10 seconds (15 s). Force Blast pushes everything in front of you away (5 s).
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_in: The Invisible Woman: a Star Fragment, a Forcefield Panel and a Potion of Invisibility. Vanish completely so monsters lose track of you, or build force fields, bubbles and blasts. Attacking ends your invisibility.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_mr: Stretch Punch reaches 10 blocks (1.5 s). Stretch Grab pulls a mob or items to you, or you to a block (4 s). Stretch Sweep spins around 6 blocks (8 s). Your reach is 3 blocks longer, and falls just bounce you.
Shape Shift: pick a shape from the wheel and use it: Boat (on water), Sofa, Trampoline, Slingshot, Bouncy Ball, Periscope Neck or Parachute.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_mr: Mr. Fantastic: a Star Fragment, a Tongue of Dog and a Ferrouslimeball. Punch and grab from ten blocks away, and reshape yourself into a boat, a trampoline, a parachute and more. You never take fall damage.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_th: Passive: rock skin with up to 40 extra health that grows back, Strength, no knockback and no fall damage. Sprinting smashes through glass and fences. You sink in water.

It's Clobberin' Time! (8 s). Wrestle suplexes a non-boss mob (10 s). Rip and Toss throws up to 4 blocks (6 s). Brace: you're slower, but you take under a third of the damage and melee attackers bounce off.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_th: The Thing: a Star Fragment, Tuff and a Heavyweight. Rock skin soaks up damage, every third punch is a combo, and you can wrestle, throw blocks and smash through glass at a sprint. You sink in water.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_ju: Paff fires one quick rocket (0.5 s). Firework Volley sends five rockets that home in on hostile mobs (6 s). Flashbang blinds and stuns everything nearby that can see you (12 s).

Pyro Jump launches you with no fall damage, or boosts you while gliding (4 s). Grand Finale rains 16 rockets on the area (60 s). Your rockets never hit pets or allies, and the Palette wheel sets their colors. Light Show lights up the ground around you.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_ju: Jubilee's power: X-Genes, a Firework Star and Pink Pigment. Shoot homing fireworks, flashbang a crowd and call down a finale of rockets. You're fragile, so keep moving.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_ga: Kinetic Throw charges whatever you're holding and throws it so it bursts on impact, or throws a card if your hand is empty (0.6 s). Thrown items are used up, and some burst with fire, frost or lightning. Card Fan throws five cards at once (4 s).

Charge Touch primes a mob or block to blow up a few seconds later, or right away if you punch it (6 s). Bo Vault leaps with no fall damage, higher with a staff (5 s). Full House sends homing cards at up to five mobs (20 s). Charged Ammo makes your arrows burst but costs hunger.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_ga: Gambit's power: X-Genes, a Drop of Luck and a Creeper Shard. Charge anything you throw so it explodes, prime blocks and mobs to blow, and throw homing cards.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_ro: Turn Gloves off and punch a mob to absorb it. It's weakened, you heal, and you keep its memory in one of three slots for 3 minutes, or 1 minute from a boss. Each memory gives you that mob's ability.

Siphon Touch lunges at a target and absorbs it (8 s). Absorbing another player borrows their powers for a minute. With Gloves off, anything that hits you in melee gets drained too. Dying wipes your memories.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_ro: Rogue's power: X-Genes, a Bottle of Blood and a Brew of Oblivion. Punch a mob to borrow its abilities for a few minutes, from creeper blasts to dragon breath.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_bi: Passive: agility, Strength III, Resistance III, Fire Resistance and flight. Fire, falls and your own explosions don't hurt you.
Photon Blast fires an exploding beam (2 s). Cosmic Dash (5 s). Binary Mode gives a damage aura, double Photon Blast damage and Resistance IV for 15 seconds (120 s).
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_bi: Captain Marvel's power, and the strongest. It isn't assembled: collide an empty syringe with a Star Fragment in the Particle Accelerator. You get flight, photon blasts and a Binary Mode that doubles your damage for 15 seconds.
guide.integrated_boogaloo.entry.serum_vi: Passive: +50 health, +16 armor, steady healing and a big cut to all damage you take. You wear Omni-Man's suit for as long as the blood is in you.
Double-tap jump to fly and sprint to cruise. Dash while flying to go supersonic. Crouch and double-jump for a fast takeoff that rips up the ground under you.
Abilities: Dash, Sonic Punch, Sky Breaker, Barrage, Thunderclap, Grab & Carry, Block, Lethal Chop and Super Speed, on the usual hero ability keys.
The Scourge Virus is the one weakness. It knocks you out of your powers while it lasts, and if you die with it, the blood is burned out of you for good.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_vi: A Viltrumite Blood Sample, a King Scale and a Queen Scale in the Assembler. The blood only comes from Viltrumites, and the scales only come from the King and Queen, so this one waits until you've beaten all of them. In return you can fly, and very little can hurt you.
task.integrated_boogaloo.super_serums_ho: You can only have one power at a time. Hold right-click with a serum to inject it, and hold right-click with an empty syringe to take it back out without losing the serum. Powers stay with you after death. Their abilities sit on R, G, V, C and X, and holding the key for a power with a wheel lets you switch its passives on and off.
task.integrated_boogaloo.big_bertha_blad: Ultimate Sword: crafted with Titanium and Uranium, ore located underground in Cavaryn
Basilisk Fang: dropped by Basilisks, located in Elythia's Ouranwood Forests
Stratoshark Fin: dropped by Stratosharks, located over Elythia's Cloud Sea
Kraken Tooth: dropped by the Kraken, located wherever a witch calls it (see the Hit List)
Lucid Eye: dropped by Lucids, located in the Lucid Pools of Thoraxis
Emperor Scorpion Stinger: dropped by Emperor Scorpions, located in the Dream Dunes of Thoraxis
Hydra Fang: dropped by the Hydra, located in the Toxic Caves of Cavaryn
Pure Darkness: dropped by the Forsaken, located in the Forlorn Hollows of Cavaryn
Heavyweight: dropped by Boundroids, located in the Magnetic Caves of Thoraxis
task.integrated_boogaloo.big_bertha_hilt: Nightmare Scale: dropped by Nightmares, located in the Nightmare Wastes of Thoraxis
Demon Heart: dropped by Demons, located in the Nightmare Wastes of Thoraxis
Molevore Nose: dropped by the Molevore, located in the Moleworm Caves of Cavaryn
Hercules Horn: dropped by Hercules Beetles, located with the swarms in Cavaryn
Springbug Leg: dropped by Springbugs, located in the Brooding Tunnels of Cavaryn

Brutalfly Wing: dropped by Brutalflies, located in cocoons in Elythia's Ouranwood Forests
Sea Serpent Fang: dropped by Sea Serpents, located in deep Overworld oceans and the Elythian Ocean
